label: heart-s5-c3

analysis.note: Keys: ischaemia_gate_204 = node 204 (the ST-depression score), steepener_3487_290 = nodes 3487/290 (the steeper second stage), age_hinge_1987 = node 1987. 'Readout only' removes the node's direct edge to the output and leaves downstream nodes unchanged; 'node with downstream' replaces the node's activation (zero or train mean) and propagates. Linear replacement = the node's activation replaced by its least-squares affine fit on its own inputs (204 on restecg:0 and oldpeak; 290 on 204; 1987 on age), propagated. Zero and mean ablation agree because each removed signal enters the logit linearly. Removing the chain takes the model to the linear-core level (0.9317); the nonlinear parts add +0.006 train AUC, and a joint linear replacement recovers 0.9355 (= L2 logistic regression).

resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. The chain 204 -> 3487 -> 290 (with 204 -> 290 as well, and both 204 and 290 read out) was kept as one two-exit leaf rather than two leaves: 3487's only input is 204, so it cannot be intercepted by an identity node (add_identity_node must leave one input un-redirected), and splitting 204 would have duplicated the gate. 3487 is a near-copy of 204 (ReLU(0.94*204 - 0.002)), so 290 = ReLU(1.818*204 - 0.470): a second, steeper threshold on the same score. Counter-directional signs reported, not explained: a normal resting ECG (restecg:0) lowers the oldpeak threshold inside the chain (raising risk) while its direct edge is -0.188; fbs:0 +0.27 directly; thal:7 only +0.025. The age hinge barely matters (readout ablation -0.0005 AUC). closed_form_max_abs_err 0.021 comes from 3-significant-figure display rounding in the nested chain formula (numeric error 1.8e-15).
tool_bugs: get_input_distribution does not accept sample_fraction (called with max_samples only; all 242 rows used). get_viz_summary requires viz_type (sensitivity and line_plot used). add_identity_node cannot intercept a node's only input (by design), which forced the two-exit leaf. compute_shap (kernel, all 242 train rows) gives the seven unconnected inputs mean |SHAP| about 0.001 instead of exactly 0 (sampling noise). The agent sandbox refused compound shell commands, so tools were called through a small Python subprocess wrapper in scratch (same species_leads/xn.py).
summary: Mostly logistic regression: 17 direct edges (logit SD 3.22; train AUC 0.932 alone) plus an ST-depression chain and an age hinge (logit SD 0.80 together) to 0.938. The chain scores oldpeak (threshold lowered by a normal resting ECG) and adds a second, much steeper stage of the same score, so oldpeak's effect is a hinge (about 0.12 logit per SD, then about 1.10 per SD above z -0.39 with a normal ECG or +0.40 without); age enters only through a small hinge starting just below the median. Same ischaemia gate as the 10-seed heart-s5 record (key 9330) and its cluster-1 sibling, but with no resting-BP offset and a free-standing age term.
